screens.title: Spanish AI slide 1 / Data ownership
screens.feature: Private ownership of Apple Health exports
screens.headline: Controla tus datos de salud
screens.subheadline: Convierte tu historial de Apple Health en archivos privados bajo tu control.
screens.prompt: Create an entirely new premium abstract portrait background for an iOS App Store screenshot for Health.md, a private health-data export app. Use a warm porcelain-white and misty-lavender field with faceted amethyst crystal geometry, soft translucent layers, and delicate violet data filaments flowing around the outer edges. The image should communicate ownership, privacy, and calm precision without literal medical imagery. Keep the upper third visually clean for a headline panel and keep the central lower area quiet for a large phone mockup that will be composited locally. Soft depth, subtle bloom, refined editorial lighting, modern Apple-quality finish. No text, letters, numbers, logos, app UI, screens, phones, device frames, watermarks, or recognizable brand marks. Portrait composition with important details inside the central safe area.
